---
title: "Quick 10"
---

The absolute must-knows — if you remember nothing else, remember these.

```{ojs}
quick10Facts = {
  const { initializeApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js");
  const { getFirestore, collection, onSnapshot } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js");

  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyD1FLnIrd86qOsFPLi5y1q_EIU0lhL5gxc",
    authDomain: "evdtoolkit.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "evdtoolkit",
    storageBucket: "evdtoolkit.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "1002374431151",
    appId: "1:1002374431151:web:fe3724bb1f39eb4744af5a"
  };

  const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const db = getFirestore(app);

  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(collection(db, "Quick10"), snapshot => {
      notify(
        snapshot.docs
          .map(d => d.data())
          .sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 999) - (b.order ?? 999))
      );
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
quick10Facts.length === 0
  ? html`<div class="fs-empty">No facts added yet — check back soon.</div>`
  : html`<details class="fs-accordion" open>
      <summary class="fs-accordion-summary" style="background:#2c7be5;">
        <span class="fs-accordion-name">🔟 Quick 10</span>
        <span class="fs-accordion-count">${quick10Facts.length}</span>
      </summary>
      <div class="fs-accordion-body">
        <ol style="margin:14px 0 6px;padding-left:20px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.9;">
          ${quick10Facts.map(f => `<li>${f.fact ?? ""}</li>`).join("")}
        </ol>
      </div>
    </details>`
```
